profile.ja: 若き最強・井河アサギの右腕として五車黎明期を支え、“幻影不知火”の異名をとる武勇と智謀に長けた対魔忍。水遁の術使いの中でも非常に珍しい、水を操り幻影を成す“幻影陣”の使い手。結婚３年目で一児の母。おっとりとした雰囲気ながら不義を許さぬ静かな情熱家。
profile.en: She is the right-hand woman of Igawa Asagi, the young and strongest, and supports the Gosha dawn period. She is a Taimanin with a reputation for "Gen'ei Shiranui" with excellent bravery and strategy, and is a rare water manipulation user who can create illusions with water. She is a mother of one child in her third year of marriage. She has a gentle atmosphere, but is a quiet and passionate person who does not tolerate injustice.

text.ja: 対魔忍、水城不知火よ。随分と若い隊長さんね。あら？　不思議そうな顔だけどどうかしたの？
text.en: I'm a Taimanin, Mizuki Shiranui. You're quite a young captain, aren't you? Hmm, you look surprised - what's wrong?

text.ja: ゆきかぜと仲良くしてくれているようね。お礼を言うわ
text.en: You're getting along with Yukikaze, I see. I'll thank you for that.

text.ja: １０年以上未来だなんて……小さかったゆきかぜもあんなに大きく成長してて、なんか感慨深いわ
text.en: Over 10 years in the future... Yukikaze, who was so small, has grown up so much - it's kind of moving, isn't it?

text.ja: あまり人妻に不躾な視線を送るものじゃないわ。ま、それだけ私が魅力的なのかしら？
text.en: You shouldn't be looking at a married woman like that. But I suppose it's because I'm just that charming?

text.ja: え？　アサギはまだ結婚してないの？　確か今もう……
text.en: What? Asagi isn't married yet? I could've sworn she was already...

text.ja: 今の対魔忍は組織が大きくなったからこそ、君みたいな若手の内から指揮官としての訓練がいるのかもね
text.en: Now that the Taimanin organization has grown, maybe we need training for young officers like you to become leaders.

text.ja: 水遁の術を極めれば、水を自在に操って幻影を見せることも可能なのよ
text.en: If I master water manipulation, I can control water and create illusions.

text.ja: 対魔忍は危険と隣り合わせだけれど、女としての幸せを求めたっていいはずよ
text.en: Being a Taimanin is dangerous, but that doesn't mean we can't pursue happiness as women.

text.ja: いやぁっ、そんな……！　だめよぉっ、あ、あなた……ごめんなさいぃ！
text.en: No, stop...! That's not okay, I... I'm sorry!

text.ja: どんなに身体を穢されようと、心だけは……ああっ、なのにどうしてこんなに感じちゃうのぉっ！？
text.en: No matter how much my body is defiled, my heart... ah, but why do I feel this way?

text.ja: そ、そんな事言わせないでっ、あぁ、んひぃっ♪　あ、あの人のより大きくて硬くて、奥までくるのぉっ！
text.en: Don't say that, ah, hmm...! It's bigger and harder than that person's, and it goes all the way in!
